description: Generate speech from input. Consumes usage in the connected project; live usage can be billed. Before generation, use whoami to verify project, environment, scopes, credit and limits. Returns inline MCP audio or an expiring resource_link, never a local file path. Host playback support varies. For integration code only, use get_started.

input.description: Text to synthesize. Maximum 2000 characters; longer text answers `400 input_too_long` naming the limit and the length you sent. Split longer scripts into several requests.

voice.description: Voice id from list_voices. Omit for the account default.

name: synthesize_speech

outputSchema.description: Hosted TTS structured result. The OAuth host returns audio_url, mime_type, bytes and expires_at plus outcome fields. Inline-only loopback HTTP omits the URL/expiry pair. Audio and resource_link blocks remain in the MCP content array. Error outcomes contain error instead of audio metadata.

audio_url.description: Expiring HTTPS download capability. Present with expires_at on the hosted OAuth server; absent for inline-only loopback HTTP.

bytes.description: Audio byte count, not base64 length.

data.description: Backward-compatible alias of the audio metadata, without outcome fields.
